code.description: Stable achievement code (the catalogue only grows).

value.description: Progress towards target, capped at it.

hidden.description: Gated off by a feature flag right now.

type.description: probe, extract_subtitles, transcode_hls, fetch_metadata, import_episodes or cleanup; rows left by older versions may carry retired types.

disabled.description: Disabling an account also signs it out everywhere.

path.description: Location under the server's data directory.

intoTier.description: XP earned inside the current tier.

percent.description: Progress through the current tier; 100 at the top tier.

tierSpan.description: XP between this tier and the next; 0 at the top tier.

away.description: The host lost its connection and the grace countdown is running.

seq.description: Increases with every state change; drop frames older than the last seen.

display.description: What is playing; absent while the host is choosing.

player.description: Absent while the host is choosing what to watch.

shareToken.description: The share code others join with.

id.description: The movie's title id or the episode id.

cpuPercent.description: Share of the whole machine's CPU capacity; -1 when unavailable.

rankingsEnabled.description: Ranks, achievements, public profiles and leaderboards.

genreId.description: The genre a genre row lists; null for other kinds.

featuredCount.description: Titles the home hero cycles through, read as 1-10 (3 when unset).

me.description: The caller's own row, listed or not.

addedLast30Days.description: Titles added in the last 30 days.

hdr.description: Media files with a high dynamic range video stream.

streams.description: Players that reported progress in the last minute.

resumePosition.description: Saved position in seconds; 0 for couch followers, who sync to the host.
